definitions.explanation: The practice of making oneself or others more attractive through various treatments and procedures.
The quality of having an attractive appearance or figure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美容|びよう}{院|いん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。

notes:
{美容|びよう} relates to beauty and cosmetic care, often appearing in compound words related to the beauty industry.

Common compounds:
- ⟦{美容|びよう}{院|いん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧ / ⟦{美容|びよう}{室|しつ}→美容室：20238_biyoushitsu⟧ (beauty salon, hair salon)
- ⟦{美容|びよう}{師|し}→美容師：15428_biyoushi⟧ (beautician, hairdresser)
- {美容|びよう}⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧ (cosmetic surgery)
- ⟦{美容|びよう}{液|えき}→美容液：16608_biyoueki⟧ (beauty serum)

Contrast:
- ⟦{美容|びよう}{院|いん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧ (beauty salon - typically for women) vs ⟦{理容|りよう}{院|いん}→理容院：27288_riyouin⟧ (barbershop - typically for men)

Related terms:
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (health) - often paired: {美容|びよう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (beauty and health)
